title: Ben's Shipment
lines: A big shipment came to Ben's shop.
The box sat on the pavement in the sun.
Ben made the payment and cut the box.
Inside was just sand and one small shell.
"This shipment is not mine," said Ben.
The man in the van had made a mistake.
At noon he came back with red kites!

questions.ask: What was in the first box?
questions.listenFor: Sand and one small shell. It is in line four and it is the joke of the story.
The man in the van. Line six says it plainly.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben was cross with the man? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Ask what in the story made them think so.
